en.description: Turn a written credit-card benefits table into one credit-rights voice clip per labeled cue. This benefits-table voice studio records each card-rights audio and rights-table voice from the list the desk already wrote, then delivers 8 to 20 credit-rights voice pack files. Use it for card-rights clip packs that keep one table item on each clip.
